product_title: Handcrafted Pink Lotus Shubh Labh Hanging Pair with Pearl Tassels
product_description: Add a vibrant and auspicious touch to your festive decor with this beautifully handcrafted Pink Lotus Shubh Labh Hanging Pair. Featuring elegant hot pink lotus motifs, intricate pearl beadwork, luxurious golden accents, and traditional Shubh Labh lettering, these decorative hangings combine cultural charm with an elegant finish. The circular golden detailing, delicate pearl borders, and graceful pearl tassels create a stunning decorative accent for your home. Perfect for decorating main doors, pooja rooms, temple entrances, walls, and festive backdrops, this hanging pair is ideal for Diwali, weddings, housewarming ceremonies, and other auspicious occasions. Bring home traditional beauty, festive warmth, and a touch of elegance with these decorative hangings.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
Avoid water and excessive moisture to protect the fabric, pearls, and decorative embellishments.
Keep away from direct sunlight for extended periods to preserve the vibrant pink color and golden finish.
Handle the pearl tassels carefully to prevent tangling, stretching, or breakage.
Do not use harsh chemicals, detergents, or abrasive cleaning materials.
Store in a dry place inside a soft cloth bag or protective box when not in use.
Keep away from sharp objects to prevent damage to the embroidery and pearl detailing.
Hang securely and avoid pulling the decorative motifs or hanging loops.
